CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.canonical_member_phone(p_phone text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
select case
 when d ~ '^254[17][0-9]{8}$' then '+'||d
 when d ~ '^0[17][0-9]{8}$' then '+254'||substring(d from 2)
 when d ~ '^[17][0-9]{8}$' then '+254'||d
 else null end from (select regexp_replace(coalesce(p_phone,''),'[^0-9]','','g') d) s;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.loan_reliability(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(score integer, sample_size integer)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
    select trunc(100.0 * count(*) filter(where status='REPAID' and completed_at <= due_date)
        / nullif(count(*),0))::integer, count(*)::integer
    from public.loans where borrower_id=p_user_id
        and (status in ('REPAID','RECOVERED_EXTERNALLY') or due_date <= now());
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.member_profile_complete(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
select coalesce((select length(trim(full_name))>0 and username ~ '^[a-zA-Z0-9_]{3,24}$'
 and username !~ '^user_[a-f0-9]{19}$'
 and trim(profile_email) ~ '^[^[:space:]@]+@[^[:space:]@]+\.[^[:space:]@]+$'
 and public.canonical_member_phone(phone) is not null
 from public.profiles where id=p_user_id),false);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.member_profile_details(p_profile_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, full_name text, username text, phone text, bio text, location text, member_since text, reliability_score integer, reliability_sample_size integer, current_debt_total bigint, current_debt_count integer, borrowing_limit bigint, available_limit bigint, previous_transaction_count integer, borrowing_count integer, completed_borrowing_count integer, minimum_borrowed bigint, maximum_borrowed bigint, average_borrowed bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
    if auth.uid() is null then raise exception 'Sign in first' using errcode='28000'; end if;
    if p_profile_id is null then raise exception 'Choose a profile'; end if;
    return query
    select p.id,p.full_name,p.username,p.phone,p.bio,p.location,
        to_char(p.created_at at time zone 'Africa/Nairobi','YYYY-MM-DD'),
        reliability.score,reliability.sample_size,
        coalesce(history.current_debt_total,0)::bigint,history.current_debt_count,
        p.borrowing_limit::bigint,
        -- Derive capacity from current principal instead of a stale cache.
        greatest(0,p.borrowing_limit-coalesce(history.outstanding_principal,0))::bigint,
        (select count(*)::integer from public.transactions t
         where (t.sender_id=p.id or t.recipient_id=p.id) and t.status='COMPLETED'),
        history.borrowing_count,history.completed_borrowing_count,
        history.minimum_borrowed,history.maximum_borrowed,history.average_borrowed
    from public.profiles p
    cross join lateral public.loan_reliability(p.id) reliability
    cross join lateral (
        select
            sum(l.total_repayment-l.amount_paid) filter(where l.status not in ('REPAID','RECOVERED_EXTERNALLY')) as current_debt_total,
            count(*) filter(where l.status not in ('REPAID','RECOVERED_EXTERNALLY'))::integer as current_debt_count,
            sum(l.principal-l.principal_paid) filter(where l.status not in ('REPAID','RECOVERED_EXTERNALLY')) as outstanding_principal,
            count(*)::integer as borrowing_count,
            count(*) filter(where l.status='REPAID')::integer as completed_borrowing_count,
            min(l.principal)::bigint as minimum_borrowed,
            max(l.principal)::bigint as maximum_borrowed,
            trunc(avg(l.principal))::bigint as average_borrowed
        from public.loans l where l.borrower_id=p.id
    ) history
    where p.id=p_profile_id;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.normalize_ke_phone(p_phone text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
    with digits as (
        select regexp_replace(coalesce(p_phone, ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g') as value
    )
    select case
        when value ~ '^0[17][0-9]{8}$' then '254' || substr(value, 2)
        when value ~ '^[17][0-9]{8}$' then '254' || value
        when value ~ '^254[17][0-9]{8}$' then value
        else value
    end
    from digits;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.public_profile_directory(p_query text DEFAULT ''::text, p_phone_numbers text[] DEFAULT ARRAY[]::text[], p_profile_ids uuid[] DEFAULT ARRAY[]::uuid[])
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, full_name text, username text, phone text, bio text, location text, profile_image text, reliability_score integer, reliability_sample_size integer, account_status text, created_at timestamp with time zone, matched_phone text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
    v_query text := lower(btrim(coalesce(p_query, '')));
    v_query_digits text := regexp_replace(coalesce(p_query, ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g');
    v_phone_numbers text[] := coalesce(p_phone_numbers, array[]::text[]);
    v_profile_ids uuid[] := coalesce(p_profile_ids, array[]::uuid[]);
begin
    if auth.uid() is null then
        raise exception 'Sign in first' using errcode = '28000';
    end if;

    if length(coalesce(p_query, '')) > 80
        or cardinality(v_phone_numbers) > 100
        or cardinality(v_profile_ids) > 100 then
        raise exception 'Directory request is too large';
    end if;

    return query
    select
        profile.id,
        profile.full_name,
        profile.username,
        ''::text,
        profile.bio,
        profile.location,
        profile.profile_image,
        (select score from public.loan_reliability(profile.id)),
        (select sample_size from public.loan_reliability(profile.id)),
        profile.account_status,
        profile.created_at,
        matched.phone
    from public.profiles as profile
    left join lateral (
        select public.normalize_ke_phone(input.phone) as phone
        from unnest(v_phone_numbers) as input(phone)
        where public.normalize_ke_phone(input.phone) = public.normalize_ke_phone(profile.phone)
        order by public.normalize_ke_phone(input.phone)
        limit 1
    ) as matched on true
    where
        (
            v_query = '' and cardinality(v_phone_numbers) = 0 and cardinality(v_profile_ids) = 0
        )
        or (
            v_query <> '' and (
                strpos(lower(profile.full_name), v_query) > 0
                or strpos(lower(profile.username), v_query) > 0
                or (
                    length(v_query_digits) >= 4
                    and strpos(public.normalize_ke_phone(profile.phone), v_query_digits) > 0
                )
            )
        )
        or matched.phone is not null
        or profile.id = any(v_profile_ids)
    order by profile.full_name, profile.id;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.refresh_profile_limit(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
    update public.profiles p set available_limit=greatest(0, p.borrowing_limit -
        (select coalesce(sum(principal-principal_paid),0) from public.loans
         where borrower_id=p.id and status not in ('REPAID','RECOVERED_EXTERNALLY')))
    where p.id=p_user_id;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.refresh_profile_statistics(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
    update public.profiles p set
        completed_loans = (select count(*) from public.loans where borrower_id = p.id and status = 'REPAID'),
        overdue_loans = (select count(*) from public.loans where borrower_id = p.id and status in ('OVERDUE','DEFAULTED')),
        active_loans = (select count(*) from public.loans where borrower_id = p.id and status not in ('REPAID','RECOVERED_EXTERNALLY')),
        total_borrowed = (select coalesce(sum(principal),0) from public.loans where borrower_id = p.id),
        total_repaid = (select coalesce(sum(amount_paid),0) from public.loans where borrower_id = p.id),
        total_supported = (select coalesce(sum(principal),0) from public.loans where lender_id = p.id),
        total_earned_from_interest = (select coalesce(sum(amount_paid - principal_paid),0) from public.loans where lender_id = p.id),
        repayment_ratio = coalesce((select score from public.loan_reliability(p.id)),0),
        reliability_score = (select score from public.loan_reliability(p.id)),
        reliability_sample_size = (select sample_size from public.loan_reliability(p.id))
    where p.id = p_user_id;
end;
$function$
